#Sqt Mal compare
##Load data
```{r}
# sqrt
cp_rep1 <- read.csv("../Output/rep1/_Global fitting Mahalanobis - tcplResult_sqartmal.csv")
cp_rep1$rep <- "rep1"
cp_rep1$is_sqrt <- TRUE

cp_rep2 <- read.csv("../Output/rep2/_Global fitting Mahalanobis - tcplResult_sqartmal.csv")
cp_rep2$rep <- "rep2"
cp_rep2$is_sqrt <- TRUE

cp_rep3 <- read.csv("../Output/rep3/_Global fitting Mahalanobis - tcplResult_sqartmal.csv")
cp_rep3$rep <- "rep3"
cp_rep3$is_sqrt <- TRUE

cp_rep4 <- read.csv("../Output/rep4/_Global fitting Mahalanobis - tcplResult_sqartmal.csv")
cp_rep4$rep <- "rep4"
cp_rep4$is_sqrt <- TRUE


# No sqrt
cp_rep1_nosqrt <- read.csv("../Output/rep1/_Global fitting Mahalanobis - tcplResult_NOTsqartmal.csv")
cp_rep1_nosqrt$rep <- "rep1"
cp_rep1_nosqrt$is_sqrt <- FALSE

cp_rep2_nosqrt <- read.csv("../Output/rep2/_Global fitting Mahalanobis - tcplResult_NOTsqartmal.csv")
cp_rep2_nosqrt$rep <- "rep2"
cp_rep2_nosqrt$is_sqrt <- FALSE

cp_rep3_nosqrt <- read.csv("../Output/rep3/_Global fitting Mahalanobis - tcplResult_NOTsqartmal.csv")
cp_rep3_nosqrt$rep <- "rep3"
cp_rep3_nosqrt$is_sqrt <- FALSE

cp_rep4_nosqrt <- read.csv("../Output/rep4/_Global fitting Mahalanobis - tcplResult_NOTsqartmal.csv")
cp_rep4_nosqrt$rep <- "rep4"
cp_rep4_nosqrt$is_sqrt <- FALSE


# Combine all
cp <- rbind(
  cp_rep1, cp_rep2, cp_rep3, cp_rep4,
  cp_rep1_nosqrt, 
  cp_rep2_nosqrt,
  cp_rep3_nosqrt, 
  cp_rep4_nosqrt
)

```

##Mutate and plotr
```{r}
cp <- cp %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(c("bmd", "name", "bmdl", "bmdu", "exp_name", "is_sqrt"))) %>%
  mutate(source = "CP") %>%
  rename(exp = exp_name) %>%
  mutate(
    name = ifelse(name == "Taxol (Paclitaxel)", "Taxol", name),
    name = ifelse(name == "Berberine Chloride", "Berberine chloride", name)
  )

shape_list <- c("rep1" =16, "rep2" =17, "rep3" =18, "rep4" =1)
plot <- ggplot(cp, aes(x = bmd, y = name, colour = is_sqrt, shape = exp)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = bmdl, xmax = bmdu), width = 0.2) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "exp", values = shape_list) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black", margin = margin(r = 5)),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
  )

plot
ggsave("../Plots/sqrt_bmd_results.png", plot, width = 15, height = 10,units = "cm")
```

##Load Columbus results
```{r}
columbus<- read.csv("../Input/Definitive_study_BMC_sqrt_vs_nosqrt.csv")

    name = ifelse(name == "Berberine Chloride", "Berberine chloride", name)
  )

  mutate(is_sqrt = Sqrt == "Squarerooted") %>%
  dplyr::select(-Sqrt)

columbus <- columbus %>%
  # rename exp IDs to reps
  dplyr::mutate(
    exp = dplyr::case_when(
      exp %in% c("Definitive_rep1") ~ "rep1",
      exp %in% c("Definitive_rep2") ~ "rep2",
      exp %in% c("Definitive_rep3") ~ "rep3",
      exp %in% c("Definitive_rep4") ~ "rep4",
      TRUE ~ exp
    )
  )

joined <- rbind(columbus, cp)

plot <- ggplot(joined, aes(x = bmd, y = name, colour = is_sqrt, shape = source)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +

    legend.position = "right",
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black", margin = margin(r = 5)),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),

plot
ggsave("../Plots/sqrt_bmd_results_columbus_cellprofiler.png", plot, width = 15, height = 10,units = "cm")
```

#New analysis comparision
##Load data
```{r}
# Load tcplfit results from a given rep's folder. Written as a self-contained
# function (rather than reassigning a shared `tcpl_results_folder` variable
# before each rep's `list.files()` call) so a stray edit or out-of-order
# chunk execution can't silently pull one rep's data from another rep's
# folder (or a non-folder path).
load_tcpl_folder <- function(folder) {
  list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) |>
    map_dfr(function(path) {
      label <- basename(path) |>
        str_remove("^tcpl_results") |>
        str_remove("\\.csv$")

      read.csv(path) |>
        mutate(
          low_variance    = str_detect(label, "lowvar"),
          pearson_thresh  = str_extract(label, "(?<=pearson_)[0-9.]+") |> as.numeric()
        )
    })
}

rep1 <- load_tcpl_folder("../Output/rep1/tcplfit_results/")
rep2 <- load_tcpl_folder("../Output/rep2/tcplfit_results/")
rep3 <- load_tcpl_folder("../Output/rep3/tcplfit_results/")
rep4 <- load_tcpl_folder("../Output/rep4/tcplfit_results/")

joined <- rbind(rep1, rep2, rep3, rep4)
```

##plot low varience
```{r}

all_results <- joined %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(c("bmd", "name", "bmdl", "bmdu", "exp_name", "pearson_thresh", "low_variance"))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(pearson_thresh)) %>% #get rid of the pearson stuff for now
  mutate(source = "CP") %>%
  rename(exp = exp_name) %>%
  mutate(
    name = ifelse(name == "Taxol (Paclitaxel)", "Taxol", name),
    name = ifelse(name == "Berberine Chloride", "Berberine chloride", name)
  )

#shape_list <- c("rep1" =16, "rep2" =17, "rep3" =18, "rep4" =1)
ggplot(all_results, aes(x = bmd, y = name, colour = exp)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = bmdl, xmax = bmdu), width = 0.2) +
  scale_x_log10() +
 # scale_shape_manual(name = "exp", values = shape_list) +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_wrap(~low_variance) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black", margin = margin(r = 5)),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
  )


```
##plot pearsons
```{r}

all_results <- joined %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(c("bmd", "name", "bmdl", "bmdu", "exp_name", "pearson_thresh", "low_variance"))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!low_variance) %>% #get rid of low varience est info
  mutate(source = "CP") %>%
  rename(exp = exp_name) %>%
  mutate(
    name = ifelse(name == "Taxol (Paclitaxel)", "Taxol", name),
    name = ifelse(name == "Berberine Chloride", "Berberine chloride", name)
  )

plot <- ggplot(all_results, aes(x = bmd, y = name, colour = pearson_thresh)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = bmdl, xmax = bmdu), width = 0.2) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(na.value = "red") +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_wrap(~exp)+
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black", margin = margin(r = 5)),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
  )

plot

# Average across reps (exp) within each chemical / pearson_thresh cutoff, so
# each name x pearson_thresh combo collapses to a single point.
all_results_avg <- all_results %>%
  group_by(name, pearson_thresh) %>%
  summarise(
    n_reps = sum(!is.na(bmd)),
    bmd = mean(bmd, na.rm = TRUE),
    bmdl = mean(bmdl, na.rm = TRUE),
    bmdu = mean(bmdu, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # mean() of all-NA groups yields NaN; keep these as NA
  mutate(across(c(bmd, bmdl, bmdu), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x), NA, .x)))

plot <- ggplot(all_results_avg, aes(x = bmd, y = name, colour = pearson_thresh)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = bmdl, xmax = bmdu), width = 0.2) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(na.value = "red") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, colour = "black", margin = margin(r = 5)),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
  )

plot
```
